  <style id="app-styles">
    @layer reset, base, component, utility, theme;
    @layer reset {
      *,
      ::before,
      ::after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html,
      body {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }
    }

    @layer base {
      :root {
        interpolate-size: allow-keywords;
        --primary: light-dark(oklch(62% 0.11 205), oklch(74% 0.085 205));
        --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.5% 0.017 205), oklch(34% 0.043 205));
        --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.088 205), oklch(73% 0.084 205));
        --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(43% 0.075 205), oklch(87% 0.065 205));
        --danger-border-soft: light-dark(oklch(77% 0.07 27), oklch(63% 0.075 27));
        --danger-border: light-dark(oklch(68% 0.095 27), oklch(69% 0.09 27));
        --focus-surface-start: light-dark(oklch(99.2% 0.005 245), oklch(27% 0.01 252));
        --focus-surface-end: light-dark(oklch(96.2% 0.012 245), oklch(24% 0.01 252));
        --success-border: light-dark(oklch(74% 0.06 156), oklch(62% 0.06 156));
        --success-glow: light-dark(oklch(61% 0.09 156 / 0.18), oklch(74% 0.07 156 / 0.2));
        --pause-border: light-dark(oklch(81% 0.06 92), oklch(70% 0.06 92));
        --pause-glow: light-dark(oklch(72% 0.08 92 / 0.2), oklch(78% 0.06 92 / 0.2));
        --radius-full: 999px;
        accent-color: var(--primary);
        --line-soft: light-dark(oklch(84.5% 0.006 248), oklch(47% 0.009 252));
        --shadow-strong: light-dark(oklch(22% 0.011 252 / 0.095), oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.38));
        --sidebar-w: 13.714286rem;
        --sidebar-collapsed-w: 4rem;
        --ease-smooth: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);
        --focus-halo-1: light-dark(oklch(64% 0.08 205 / 0.12), oklch(72% 0.07 205 / 0.12));
        --task-tree-indent: 2.65rem;
        --task-tree-node-indent: 0.86rem;
        --theme-dot-ring: light-dark(oklch(99.5% 0.003 248 / 0.96), oklch(23% 0.01 252 / 0.96));
        --theme-dot-outline: light-dark(oklch(52% 0.012 248 / 0.22), oklch(3% 0 0 / 0.4));
        --toggle-knob: light-dark(oklch(99.5% 0.003 248), oklch(23% 0.01 252));
        --mode-switch-track: light-dark(oklch(32% 0.02 252), oklch(33% 0.02 252));
        --mode-switch-track-active: light-dark(oklch(74% 0.11 233), oklch(46% 0.07 233));
        --mode-switch-moon: light-dark(oklch(99% 0.003 248), oklch(95% 0.01 252));
        --mode-switch-sun: light-dark(oklch(88% 0.14 90), oklch(86% 0.12 90));
        --mode-switch-star: light-dark(oklch(97% 0.01 248), oklch(96% 0.01 252));
        --mode-switch-cloud: light-dark(oklch(99% 0.003 248), oklch(99% 0.003 252));

        &[data-theme="theme-2"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(63% 0.11 206), oklch(74% 0.085 206));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.5% 0.017 206), oklch(34% 0.043 206));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.088 206), oklch(73% 0.084 206));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(43% 0.075 206), oklch(87% 0.065 206));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-1"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(64% 0.095 157.2), oklch(75% 0.075 157.2));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.5% 0.015 157.2), oklch(34% 0.035 157.2));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.078 157.2), oklch(73% 0.072 157.2));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(44% 0.07 157.2), oklch(88% 0.058 157.2));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-3"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(67% 0.108 84.8), oklch(77% 0.085 84.8));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.8% 0.02 84.8), oklch(35% 0.04 84.8));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(66% 0.086 84.8), oklch(74% 0.078 84.8));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(45% 0.078 84.8), oklch(88% 0.064 84.8));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-4"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(64% 0.1 18.5), oklch(75% 0.078 18.5));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.6% 0.016 18.5), oklch(34% 0.036 18.5));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.08 18.5), oklch(73% 0.074 18.5));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(44% 0.072 18.5), oklch(87% 0.06 18.5));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-5"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(60% 0.118 12.4), oklch(73% 0.094 12.4));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.6% 0.019 12.4), oklch(33% 0.042 12.4));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.09 12.4), oklch(72% 0.082 12.4));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(42% 0.082 12.4), oklch(86% 0.066 12.4));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-6"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(62% 0.07 283.9), oklch(74% 0.056 283.9));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.6% 0.012 283.9), oklch(33% 0.03 283.9));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.062 283.9), oklch(72% 0.06 283.9));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(43% 0.058 283.9), oklch(87% 0.05 283.9));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-7"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(63% 0.098 194.1), oklch(74% 0.076 194.1));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.6% 0.016 194.1), oklch(34% 0.039 194.1));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(65% 0.082 194.1), oklch(73% 0.076 194.1));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(43% 0.073 194.1), oklch(87% 0.061 194.1));
        }

        &[data-theme="theme-8"] {
          --primary: light-dark(oklch(58% 0.038 251.9), oklch(70% 0.032 251.9));
          --primary-bg-faint: light-dark(oklch(96.7% 0.007 251.9), oklch(33% 0.016 251.9));
          --primary-border-strong: light-dark(oklch(66% 0.034 251.9), oklch(72% 0.033 251.9));
          --primary-text-ink: light-dark(oklch(42% 0.03 251.9), oklch(86% 0.026 251.9));
        }
      }
    }

    @layer component {
      body {
        -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        text-rendering: optimizelegibility;
        min-height: 100vh;
        overflow-x: hidden;

        &.sidebar-collapsed .shell {
          grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-collapsed-w) 1fr;
        }

        &.focus-open {
          overflow: hidden;
        }

        &.sidebar-collapsed {
          & .brand {
            display: none;
          }

          & .nav-label {
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            max-width: 0;
            transform: translate(-0.285714rem);
          }

          & .brand-title {
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            width: 0;
            max-width: 0;
            transform: translate(-0.428571rem);
          }

          & .nav-btn {
            margin-inline: auto;
          }

          & .nav {
            justify-items: center;
          }

          & .sidebar-top {
            flex-direction: row;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0;
          }

          & .sidebar-collapse-btn {
            margin: 0 auto;
          }
        }
      }

      .icon-sprite-defs {
        pointer-events: none;
        width: 0;
        height: 0;
        position: absolute;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .material-symbols-outlined {
        vertical-align: middle;
        user-select: none;
        pointer-events: none;
        color: currentColor;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        width: 1em;
        height: 1em;
        font-size: 1.285714rem;
        line-height: 1;
        display: inline-flex;

        & > svg {
          stroke: none;
          fill: currentColor;
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          display: block;
        }
      }

      .shell {
        grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-w) 1fr;
        min-height: 100vh;
        transition: grid-template-columns 0.18s var(--ease-smooth);
        display: grid;
      }

      .sidebar {
        height: 100vh;
        transition: padding 0.18s var(--ease-smooth);
        grid-template-rows: auto auto 1fr;
        display: grid;
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;

        @media (width <= 56.25em) {
          border-block-end: none;
          height: auto;
          position: static;
        }
      }

      .sidebar-top {
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .brand {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.2rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
      }

      .brand-title {
        transition:
          opacity 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        white-space: nowrap;
        line-height: 1.35;
      }

      .sidebar-collapse-btn {
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .nav {
        display: grid;

        @media (width <= 56.25em) {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        }
      }

      .nav-btn {
        appearance: none;
        width: 100%;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .nav-icon {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        width: 1.15rem;
        display: inline-flex;
      }

      .nav-label {
        max-width: 10rem;
        transition:
          opacity 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          max-width 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        white-space: nowrap;
        display: inline-block;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      .main {
        place-items: start center;
        display: grid;
      }

      .page-wrap {
        display: grid;
      }

      .page {
        animation: pageIn 0.18s var(--ease-smooth);
        display: none;

        &.active {
          display: grid;
        }
      }

      @keyframes pageIn {
        0% {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(0.428571rem);
        }

        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
      }

      .card {
        & h2 {
          font-weight: 800;
        }
      }

      .row {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        display: flex;
      }

      .text-input {
        transition:
          border-color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          box-shadow 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        outline: none;
        flex: 1;
      }

      .icon-btn,
      .mini-btn,
      .message-chip-btn,
      .focus-btn {
        appearance: none;
        transition:
          transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          filter 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          border-color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          box-shadow 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      .task-list {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
        display: grid;
      }

      .task-item {
        content-visibility: auto;
        contain-intrinsic-block-size: auto var(--task-estimated-size, 4rem);

        &:focus-within { content-visibility: visible; }
        gap: 0.7rem;
        display: grid;
        position: relative;

        &.done .task-title {
          color: var(--completed-text);
          text-decoration: line-through 0.142857rem;
        }
      }

      .task-main {
        grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.7rem;
        display: grid;
      }

      .task-meta {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
      }

      .task-title {
        word-break: break-word;
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .achievement-time {
        border: 1px solid var(--line);
        border-radius: var(--radius-full);
        letter-spacing: 0.01em;
        align-items: center;
        width: fit-content;
        font-weight: 650;
        line-height: 1.25;
        display: inline-flex;

        & .material-symbols-outlined {
          color: var(--primary);
        }
      }

      .task-achievement {
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .task-focus-wrap {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.34rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: inline-flex;
      }

      .task-tools {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        display: flex;

        @media (width <= 42.5em) {
          grid-column: 3;
          justify-self: end;
        }
      }

      .subtask-wrap {
        display: grid;
      }

      .subtask-list {
        min-height: 0.714286rem;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
        display: grid;
      }

      .subtask-item {
        transition:
          background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          border-color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          opacity 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.55rem;
        display: grid;
        position: relative;

        & .text {
          word-break: break-word;
          min-width: 0;
        }

        &.done .text {
          color: var(--completed-text);
          text-decoration: line-through 0.142857rem;
        }
      }

      .subtask-text-wrap {
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        min-width: 0;
        display: flex;
      }

      .subtask-achievement {
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .subtask-actions {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        display: flex;
      }

      .empty {
        text-align: center;
        color: var(--muted);
        place-items: center;
        line-height: 1.7;
        display: grid;
      }

      .empty-title {
        color: var(--text);
      }

      .setting-list {
        display: grid;
      }

      .setting-item {
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.9rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .setting-meta {
        gap: 0.22rem;
        display: grid;
      }

      .setting-title {
        font-weight: 800;
      }

      .pomodoro-rhythm-card {
        gap: 0.72rem;
        display: grid;

        &.is-disabled {
          opacity: 0.72;
        }
      }

      .pomodoro-rhythm-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: 0.7rem;
        display: grid;
      }

      .pomodoro-field {
        display: grid;
      }

      .pomodoro-field-label {
        color: var(--muted);
      }

      .pomodoro-number-input {
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }

      .pomodoro-help {
        line-height: 1.5;
      }

      .theme-grid {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.55rem;
        display: flex;
      }

      .theme-btn {
        appearance: none;
        aspect-ratio: 1;
        transition:
          border-color 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          box-shadow 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth),
          background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        flex: none;
        place-items: center;
      }

      .theme-dot {
        border: 0.142857rem solid var(--theme-dot-ring);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--theme-dot-outline);
        border-radius: 50%;
      }

      .toggle {
        appearance: none;
        background: var(--line-strong);
        cursor: pointer;
        width: 3.2rem;
        height: 1.85rem;
        transition: background 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
        border: none;
        border-radius: 999px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        position: relative;

        &::after {
          content: "";
          background: var(--toggle-knob);
          width: 1.45rem;
          height: 1.45rem;
          transition: transform 0.16s var(--ease-smooth);
          border-radius: 50%;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0.2rem;
          left: 0.2rem;
          box-shadow: 0 0.142857rem 0.571429rem #00000026;
        }

        &:checked {
          background: var(--primary);

          &::after {
            transform: translate(1.35rem);
          }
        }
      }

      .switch {
        border-radius: 2.142857rem;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        width: 4em;
        height: 2.2em;
        font-size: 1.214286rem;
        display: inline-block;
        position: relative;

        & input {
          opacity: 0;
          width: 0;
          height: 0;

          &:checked + .slider {
            background-color: var(--mode-switch-track-active);

            &::before {
              box-shadow: inset 1.071429rem -0.285714rem 0 1.071429rem var(--mode-switch-sun);
              transform: translate(1.8em);
            }

            & .star {

      const DEFAULT_POMODORO_BREAK_MINUTES = 5;

      const STORAGE_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS = 4000;
      const FAVICON_SIZE = 64;
      const MAX_FAVICON_BADGE_COUNT = 99;
      // ボタンの読み上げ名を共用し、titleや別属性に文言を重複させない。
      const TOOLTIP_SELECTOR = 'button[aria-label]:not(.theme-btn)';
      const TOOLTIP_OFFSET_PX = 5;
      const TOOLTIP_VIEWPORT_PADDING_PX = 8;
      const DELETE_UNDO_WINDOW_MS = 5000;

        button:not([disabled]),
        [href],
        input:not([type="hidden"]):not([disabled]),
        select:not([disabled]),
        textarea:not([disabled]),

      let _storageWarningEl = null;
      let _storageWarningReason = '';
      let _indexedDbPromise = null;
      let _indexedDbWriteQueue = Promise.resolve();
      let _storedStateSaveQueue = Promise.resolve();
      let _lastIndexedDbWriteError = null;

      /* 保存ヘルパー開始 */
      function _safeStorageGet(storage, key, onError = null) {
        try {
          return storage.getItem(key);
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('read', error, { key });
          return null;
        }
      }

        try {
          storage.setItem(key, value);
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('write', error, { key, value });
          return false;
        }
      }

      function _safeStorageRemove(storage, key, onError = null) {
        try {
          storage.removeItem(key);
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('remove', error, { key });
          return false;
        }
      }

      function _createCorruptStorageBackupValue(raw) {
        if (raw.length <= MAX_CORRUPT_STORAGE_BACKUP_CHARS) return raw;
        const marker = `\n[truncated corrupt storage value; original chars: ${raw.length}]`;
        const safeLength = Math.max(0, MAX_CORRUPT_STORAGE_BACKUP_CHARS - marker.length);
        return `${raw.slice(0, safeLength)}${marker}`;
      }

      function _backupCorruptStorageValue({
        storage,
        key,
        raw,
        onError = null
      }) {
        const backupKey = `${key}${CORRUPT_STORAGE_BACKUP_SUFFIX}`;
        const backupValue = _createCorruptStorageBackupValue(raw);
        const existingBackup = _safeStorageGet(storage, backupKey, onError);
        const hasBackup = existingBackup === backupValue
          || (existingBackup == null && _safeStorageSet(storage, backupKey, backupValue, onError));
        // 文字数を制限したプレビューでは、元データを完全には復元できない。
        if (hasBackup && backupValue === raw && _safeStorageGet(storage, key, onError) === raw) {
          _safeStorageRemove(storage, key, onError);
        }
      }

      function _snapshotStorageEntry(storage, key, onError = null) {
        try {
          return {
            ok: true,
            value: storage.getItem(key)
          };
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('read', error, { key });
          return {
            ok: false,
            value: null
          };
        }
      }

      function _restoreStorageEntry(storage, key, value, onError = null) {
        try {
          if (value == null) {
            storage.removeItem(key);
          } else {
            storage.setItem(key, value);
          }
          return true;
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('rollback', error, { key, value });
          return false;
        }
      }

      function _rollbackStorageWrites(storage, snapshots, writtenKeys, onError = null) {
        let rollbackOk = true;
        const restoredKeys = new Set();
        for (let index = writtenKeys.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
          const key = writtenKeys[index];
          if (restoredKeys.has(key)) continue;
          restoredKeys.add(key);
          if (!_restoreStorageEntry(storage, key, snapshots.get(key), onError)) {
            rollbackOk = false;
          }
        }
        return rollbackOk;
      }

      function _readJsonFromStorage({
        storage,
        key,
        fallback,
        validate = null,
        onError = null
      }) {
        const raw = _safeStorageGet(storage, key, onError);
        if (raw == null || raw === '') return fallback;

        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (validate && !validate(parsed)) {
            onError?.('validate', new Error(`Validation failed for key: ${key}`), { key, raw });
            return fallback;
          }
          return parsed;
        } catch (error) {
          onError?.('parse', error, { key, raw });
          _backupCorruptStorageValue({ storage, key, raw, onError });
          return fallback;
        }
      }

      function _readBooleanFromStorage({
        storage,
        key,
        fallback = false,
        onError = null
      }) {
        const raw = _safeStorageGet(storage, key, onError);
        if (raw == null) return fallback;
        if (raw === 'true') return true;
        if (raw === 'false') return false;
        return fallback;
      }

      function _writeManyToStorage({
        storage,
        entries,
        onError = null
      }) {
        const writeEntries = Array.isArray(entries) ? entries : [];
        const snapshots = new Map();
        for (const [key] of writeEntries) {
          if (snapshots.has(key)) continue;
          const snapshot = _snapshotStorageEntry(storage, key, onError);
          if (!snapshot.ok) {
            return false;
          }
          snapshots.set(key, snapshot.value);
        }

        const writtenKeys = [];
        const currentValues = new Map(snapshots);
        for (const [key, value] of writeEntries) {
          if (currentValues.get(key) === value) continue;
          if (!_safeStorageSet(storage, key, value, onError)) {
            writtenKeys.push(key);
            _rollbackStorageWrites(storage, snapshots, writtenKeys, onError);
            return false;
          }
          writtenKeys.push(key);
          currentValues.set(key, value);
        }
        return true;
      }

      function _createStorageWriteId() {
        return globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.()
          || `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
      }

      function _requestIndexedDbOpen() {
        if (!globalThis.indexedDB) {
          return Promise.resolve(null);
        }
        if (_indexedDbPromise) {
          return _indexedDbPromise;
        }

        _indexedDbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const request = indexedDB.open(INDEXED_DB_NAME, INDEXED_DB_VERSION);
          let settled = false;
          const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
            finish(new Error('indexedDB open timed out'));
          }, STORAGE_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS);
          function finish(error = null, db = null) {
            if (settled) {
              db?.close();
              return;
            }
            settled = true;
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            if (error) reject(error);
            else {
              const openedPromise = _indexedDbPromise;
              const invalidateConnection = () => {
                if (_indexedDbPromise === openedPromise) _indexedDbPromise = null;
              };
              db.onversionchange = () => {
                db.close();
                invalidateConnection();
              };
              db.onclose = invalidateConnection;
              resolve(db);
            }
          }
          request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
            const db = request.result;
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME)) {
              db.createObjectStore(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME);
            }
          };
          request.onsuccess = () => finish(null, request.result);
          request.onerror = () => finish(request.error || new Error('indexedDB open failed'));
          request.onblocked = () => finish(new Error('indexedDB open blocked'));
        });

        _indexedDbPromise.catch(() => {
          _indexedDbPromise = null;
        });

        return _indexedDbPromise;
      }

      function _waitForIndexedDbRequest(request) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
          request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error('indexedDB request failed'));
        });
      }

      function _waitForIndexedDbTransaction(tx) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          let settled = false;
          const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
            finish(new Error('indexedDB transaction timed out'));
            try { tx.abort(); } catch { /* トランザクションはすでに終了している場合がある。 */ }
          }, STORAGE_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS);
          function finish(error = null) {
            if (settled) return;
            settled = true;
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            if (error) reject(error);
            else resolve(true);
          }
          tx.oncomplete = () => finish();
          tx.onabort = () => finish(tx.error || new Error('indexedDB transaction aborted'));
          tx.onerror = () => finish(tx.error || new Error('indexedDB transaction failed'));
        });

      async function _readManyFromIndexedDb(keys) {

        const txDone = _waitForIndexedDbTransaction(tx);

          const store = tx.objectStore(INDEXED_DB_STORE_NAME);
          // トランザクションが有効な間に全リクエストを登録し、コミット完了を待つ。
          const reads = keys.map(async (key) => {
            const value = await _waitForIndexedDbRequest(store.get(key));
            return [key, value == null ? null : String(value)];
          });
          const [entries] = await Promise.all([Promise.all(reads), txDone]);
          return Object.fromEntries(entries);
        } catch (error) {
          try { tx.abort(); } catch { /* トランザクションはすでに終了している場合がある。 */ }
          await txDone.catch(() => false);
          throw error;
        }
      }

      /* 保存ヘルパー終了 */

      function _reportStorageError(mode, key, error) {

      function _getStorageWarningEl() {

      function _normalizeStorageMeta(raw) {

      function _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(source) {

        function readIdentity(value) {
          if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;
          const readNumber = (number) => {
            if (typeof number !== 'number' && typeof number !== 'string') return NaN;
            if (typeof number === 'string' && !number.trim()) return NaN;
            return Number(number);
          };
          const revision = readNumber(value.revision);
          const updatedAt = readNumber(value.updatedAt);
          const writeId = typeof value.writeId === 'string' ? value.writeId.trim() : '';
          if (!Number.isFinite(revision) && !Number.isFinite(updatedAt) && !writeId) return null;
          return {
            revision: Number.isFinite(revision) ? Math.max(0, revision) : 0,
            updatedAt: Number.isFinite(updatedAt) ? Math.max(0, updatedAt) : 0,
            writeId

        const identity = readIdentity(source);
        if (!identity) return null;
        return {
          ...identity,
          writerId: typeof source.writerId === 'string' ? source.writerId.trim() : '',

          ...(source.unloadBase ? {

          updatedAt: normalized?.updatedAt || 0,
          writeId: normalized?.writeId || ''

      function _compareStorageMeta(a, b) {
        if (!a && !b) return 0;
        if (a && !b) return 1;
        if (!a && b) return -1;
        if (a.revision !== b.revision) return a.revision - b.revision;
        if (a.updatedAt !== b.updatedAt) return a.updatedAt - b.updatedAt;
        return String(a.writeId || '').localeCompare(String(b.writeId || ''));
      }

      function _isEmptyStorageMeta(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        return !normalized
          || (
            normalized.revision === 0
            && normalized.updatedAt === 0
            && !normalized.writeId
          );
      }

      function _isSameStorageMeta(a, b) {
        if (_isEmptyStorageMeta(a) && _isEmptyStorageMeta(b)) return true;
        const left = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(a);
        const right = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(b);
        if (!left || !right) return false;
        return left.revision === right.revision
          && left.updatedAt === right.updatedAt
          && (left.writeId || '') === (right.writeId || '');
      }

      function _hasStorageMetaConflictSince(currentMeta, baselineMeta) {
        if (_isSameStorageMeta(currentMeta, baselineMeta)) return false;
        const current = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(currentMeta);
        const baseline = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(baselineMeta);
        if (!current || _isEmptyStorageMeta(current)) return false;
        if (!baseline || _isEmptyStorageMeta(baseline)) return true;
        if (current.revision < baseline.revision) return false;
        return true;
      }

      function _isVerifiedCheckpointAncestor(indexedMeta, checkpointMeta) {
        if (!checkpointMeta?.unloadBase || !indexedMeta || indexedMeta.unloadBase) return false;
        if (_isSameStorageMeta(indexedMeta, checkpointMeta)) return true;
        // 同じタブ内の書き込みは順番に実行する。進行中のトランザクションに続いて離脱する場合も、
        // その後に作られた下書きをコミットで失わないようにする。
        return !!checkpointMeta.writerId
          && indexedMeta.writerId === checkpointMeta.writerId
          && indexedMeta.revision > checkpointMeta.unloadBase.revision
          && indexedMeta.revision < checkpointMeta.revision;
      }

      function _getCurrentStorageMeta() {
        return {
          revision: _persistedStateRevision,
          updatedAt: _persistedStateUpdatedAt,
          writeId: _persistedStateWriteId,
          writerId: _persistedStateWriterId,
          ...(_persistedStateUnloadBase ? { unloadBase: _persistedStateUnloadBase } : {})
        };
      }

      function _getStorageMetaFromEntries(entries) {
        if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return null;
        const metaEntry = entries.find(([key]) => key === STATE_META_KEY);
        return _normalizeStorageMeta(metaEntry?.[1]);
      }

      function _hasCurrentStorageMetaChangedSince(meta) {
        return !_isSameStorageMeta(_getCurrentStorageMeta(), meta);
      }

      function _hasAnySnapshotData(values) {
        return PERSISTED_DATA_KEYS.some((key) => {
          const raw = values[key];
          return raw != null && raw !== '';
        });
      }

      function _readLocalStateSnapshot() {
        const values = Object.fromEntries(PERSISTED_STATE_KEYS.map((key) => [
          key,
          _safeStorageGet(LOCAL_STORAGE, key, (mode, error, meta) => {
            _reportStorageError(`local-${mode}`, meta?.key ?? key, error);
          })

        return _validatePersistentStateSnapshot({
          source: 'local',
          values,
          meta: _normalizeStorageMeta(values[STATE_META_KEY]),
          hasAnyData: _hasAnySnapshotData(values)

      }

      function _createIndexedStateSnapshot(values) {
        return _validatePersistentStateSnapshot({
          source: 'indexeddb',
          values,
          meta: _normalizeStorageMeta(values[STATE_META_KEY]),
          hasAnyData: _hasAnySnapshotData(values)
        });
      }

      function _validatePersistentStateSnapshot(snapshot) {
        const values = snapshot?.values || {};
        const invalidKeys = [];
        if (!snapshot?.hasAnyData) {
          return { ...snapshot, isValid: true, invalidKeys };
        }

        // 世代付きスナップショットは、欠落のない一つの状態として一括で保存する。
        if (snapshot.meta) {
          PERSISTED_DATA_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
            if (values[key] == null) invalidKeys.push(key);
          });
        }

        const jsonValidators = [
          [TASKS_KEY, Array.isArray],
          [SETTINGS_KEY, (value) => !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)],
          [TASK_VIEW_KEY, (value) => !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)]
        ];
        jsonValidators.forEach(([key, validate]) => {
          const raw = values[key];
          if (raw == null) return;
          try {
            if (!validate(JSON.parse(raw))) invalidKeys.push(key);
          } catch {
            invalidKeys.push(key);
          }
        });
        if (values[SIDEBAR_KEY] != null && !['true', 'false'].includes(values[SIDEBAR_KEY])) {
          invalidKeys.push(SIDEBAR_KEY);
        }

        const uniqueInvalidKeys = [...new Set(invalidKeys)];
        return {
          ...snapshot,
          isValid: uniqueInvalidKeys.length === 0,
          invalidKeys: uniqueInvalidKeys
        };
      }

      function _shouldUseIndexedState(localSnapshot, indexedSnapshot) {
        if (!indexedSnapshot.hasAnyData || !indexedSnapshot.isValid) return false;
        if (!localSnapshot.hasAnyData || !localSnapshot.isValid) return true;

        // 離脱時の同期チェックポイントはIndexedDBを未確認のため、時刻や世代番号だけで、
        // 確認済みの基準以降に行われた書き込みより新しいとは判定しない。
        if (
          localSnapshot.meta?.unloadBase
          && !_isVerifiedCheckpointAncestor(indexedSnapshot.meta, localSnapshot.meta)
          && _hasStorageMetaConflictSince(indexedSnapshot.meta, localSnapshot.meta.unloadBase)
        ) return true;

        // localStorageを先に保存していた旧版で分離した、同一世代の保存内容を復元する。
        // 両方がコミット済みを示す場合は、トランザクションを持つIndexedDBを正とする。
        if (!localSnapshot.meta?.unloadBase && indexedSnapshot.meta && localSnapshot.meta
          && indexedSnapshot.meta.revision === localSnapshot.meta.revision
          && !_isSameStorageMeta(indexedSnapshot.meta, localSnapshot.meta)) return true;

        const metaComparison = _compareStorageMeta(indexedSnapshot.meta, localSnapshot.meta);
        if (metaComparison !== 0) return metaComparison > 0;

        return false;
      }

      function _adoptStorageMeta(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        if (!normalized) return;
        if (_compareStorageMeta(normalized, _getCurrentStorageMeta()) > 0) {
          _setCurrentStorageMeta(normalized);
        }
      }

      function _createStorageMetaRecord(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        const record = {
          version: 1,
          revision: Math.max(0, Number(normalized?.revision) || 0),
          updatedAt: Math.max(0, Number(normalized?.updatedAt) || 0),
          writeId: normalized?.writeId || _createStorageWriteId(),
          writerId: normalized?.writerId || STORAGE_TAB_ID
        };
        if (normalized?.base) {
          record.base = _createStorageMetaIdentity(normalized.base);
        }
        if (normalized?.unloadBase) record.unloadBase = normalized.unloadBase;
        return record;
      }

      function _setCurrentStorageMeta(meta) {
        const normalized = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(meta);
        _persistedStateRevision = Math.max(0, Number(normalized?.revision) || 0);
        _persistedStateUpdatedAt = Math.max(0, Number(normalized?.updatedAt) || 0);
        _persistedStateWriteId = normalized?.writeId || '';
        _persistedStateWriterId = normalized?.writerId || '';
        _persistedStateUnloadBase = normalized?.unloadBase || null;
      }

      function _createNextStorageMeta(baseMeta = _getCurrentStorageMeta(), options = {}) {
        const normalizedBase = _normalizeStorageMetaRecord(baseMeta) || {
          revision: 0,
          updatedAt: 0,
          writeId: ''
        };
        const now = Date.now();
        const storageMeta = {
          version: 1,
          revision: Math.max(0, normalizedBase.revision) + 1,
          updatedAt: now,
          writeId: _createStorageWriteId(),
          writerId: STORAGE_TAB_ID,
          base: _createStorageMetaIdentity(normalizedBase.unloadBase || normalizedBase)
        };
        if (options.unverified) storageMeta.unloadBase = storageMeta.base;
        _setCurrentStorageMeta(storageMeta);
        return storageMeta;
      }

      function _restoreStorageMeta(meta) {
        _setCurrentStorageMeta(meta);
      }

      function _getDataEntries(entries) {
        if (!Array.isArray(entries)) return [];

      function formatFileSize(bytes) {
        const normalizedBytes = Math.max(0, Number(bytes) || 0);
        if (normalizedBytes >= 1024 * 1024) {

          return `${mb.toFixed(mb >= 10 ? 0 : 1)}MB`;
        }
        if (normalizedBytes >= 1024) {
          const kb = normalizedBytes / 1024;
          return `${kb.toFixed(kb >= 10 ? 0 : 1)}KB`;

      function setFocusStartControlPending(controlEl, isPending) {

      function setFocusOperationPending(isPending) {
        const pending = !!isPending;
        if (pending && !focusOperationState.pending) {

      function _createAppStateSnapshot() {
        return {
          _stateVersion: _appStateVersion,
          _focusRuntime: _createFocusRuntimeSnapshot(),
          tasks: _copyTaskSnapshot(tasks),
          settings: _copyTaskSnapshot(settings),
          sidebarCollapsed: !!isSidebarCollapsed,
          organizeMemo,
          taskView: _copyTaskSnapshot(taskViewState)
        };
      }

      function _applyAppStateSnapshot(snapshot, options = {}) {
        if (!snapshot || typeof snapshot !== 'object') return;
        const previousPomodoro = JSON.stringify(settings.pomodoro);
        tasks = normalizeTasks(snapshot.tasks, {
          preserveRunningFocus: !!options?.preserveRunningFocus
        });
        settings = normalizeSettings(snapshot.settings);
        if (previousPomodoro !== JSON.stringify(settings.pomodoro)) {
          syncPomodoroSettingsControls(settings.pomodoro);
        }
        isSidebarCollapsed = !!snapshot.sidebarCollapsed;
        organizeMemo = normalizeOrganizeMemo(snapshot.organizeMemo);
        const normalizedTaskView = normalizeTaskViewState(snapshot.taskView);
        taskViewState.filter = normalizedTaskView.filter;
        if (organizeMemoInput) organizeMemoInput.value = organizeMemo;
        applySidebarState();
        setMemoSaveStatus('saved');
      }

      function _restoreStateAfterFailedSave(snapshot, message = '保存できなかったため変更を取り消しました', options = {}) {
        const expectedVersion = Number.isInteger(options?.expectedVersion) ? options.expectedVersion : null;
        if (!_canRestoreFailedSaveSnapshot(expectedVersion)) {
          _showSkippedRollbackToast();
          return false;
        }
        // 同じセッション内での復元なので、無関係な作業を停止する再読み込み用の正規化は使わない。
        _applyAppStateSnapshot(snapshot, { preserveRunningFocus: true });
        if (snapshot?._focusRuntime) _applyFocusRuntimeSnapshot(snapshot._focusRuntime);
        _markAppStateChanged();
        render();
        showErrorToast(message);
        return true;
      }

      async function _commitStateSave(previousState, message = '保存できなかったため変更を取り消しました') {
        setStateSaveOperationPending(true);
        try {
          const restoreVersion = _markAppStateChanged();
          if (await save()) return true;
          _restoreStateAfterFailedSave(previousState, message, { expectedVersion: restoreVersion });
          return false;
        } finally {
          setStateSaveOperationPending(false);
        }
      }

      function _createFocusRuntimeSnapshot() {
        return {
          type: focusState.type,
          parentId: focusState.parentId,
          subtaskId: focusState.subtaskId,
          lastCheckpointAt: focusState.lastCheckpointAt,
          pomodoroEnabled: focusState.pomodoroEnabled,
          pomodoroPhase: focusState.pomodoroPhase,
          pomodoroPhaseEndsAt: focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt,
          pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs: focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs,
          pomodoroFocusMs: focusState.pomodoroFocusMs,
          pomodoroBreakMs: focusState.pomodoroBreakMs
        };
      }

      function _applyFocusRuntimeSnapshot(snapshot) {
        if (!snapshot || typeof snapshot !== 'object') return;
        focusState.type = snapshot.type || null;
        focusState.parentId = snapshot.parentId || null;
        focusState.subtaskId = snapshot.subtaskId || null;
        focusState.lastCheckpointAt = Number(snapshot.lastCheckpointAt) || 0;
        focusState.pomodoroEnabled = !!snapshot.pomodoroEnabled;
        focusState.pomodoroPhase = snapshot.pomodoroPhase === 'break' ? 'break' : 'focus';
        focusState.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt = typeof snapshot.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt === 'number' ? snapshot.pomodoroPhaseEndsAt : null;
        focusState.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs = Number(snapshot.pomodoroPhaseRemainingMs) || 0;
        focusState.pomodoroFocusMs = Number(snapshot.pomodoroFocusMs) || 0;
        focusState.pomodoroBreakMs = Number(snapshot.pomodoroBreakMs) || 0;
        syncFocusPauseButton();
        updateFocusTimer();
      }

      function _restoreFocusStateAfterFailedSave(
        appSnapshot,
        focusSnapshot,
        message = '保存できなかったため変更を取り消しました',
        options = {}
      ) {
        const expectedVersion = Number.isInteger(options?.expectedVersion) ? options.expectedVersion : null;
        if (!_canRestoreFailedSaveSnapshot(expectedVersion)) {
          _showSkippedRollbackToast();
          return false;
        }
        _applyAppStateSnapshot(appSnapshot, { preserveRunningFocus: true });
        _applyFocusRuntimeSnapshot(focusSnapshot);
        _markAppStateChanged();
        render();
        showErrorToast(message);
        return true;
      }

      async function _commitFocusStateSave(
        previousState,
        previousFocusState,
        message = '保存できなかったため変更を取り消しました'
      ) {
        setStateSaveOperationPending(true);
        try {
          const restoreVersion = _markAppStateChanged();
          if (await save()) return true;
          _restoreFocusStateAfterFailedSave(previousState, previousFocusState, message, {
            expectedVersion: restoreVersion
          });
          return false;
        } finally {
          setStateSaveOperationPending(false);
        }
      }

      function _isValidDeleteUndoPayload(payload) {
        if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') return false;
        const removedParents = Array.isArray(payload.removedParents) ? payload.removedParents : [];
        const removedSubtasks = Array.isArray(payload.removedSubtasks) ? payload.removedSubtasks : [];
        return removedParents.length > 0 || removedSubtasks.length > 0;
      }

      function _createDeleteUndoRestorePlan(payload) {
        if (!_isValidDeleteUndoPayload(payload)) return null;

        const existingParentIds = new Set(tasks.map(task => task.id));
        const plannedParentIds = new Set();
        const plannedParentsById = new Map();
        const restoreParents = [];
        const sortedParents = Array.isArray(payload.removedParents)
          ? payload.removedParents.toSorted((a, b) => (a?.index ?? 0) - (b?.index ?? 0))
          : [];

        for (const entry of sortedParents) {
          const parentId = entry?.task?.id;
          if (!parentId) continue;
          if (existingParentIds.has(parentId) || plannedParentIds.has(parentId)) continue;
          const task = _copyTaskSnapshot(entry.task);
          if (!Array.isArray(task.subtasks)) task.subtasks = [];
          if (task.subtasks.length > MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT) {
            return { ok: false, reason: 'subtask-limit' };
          }
          plannedParentIds.add(parentId);
          plannedParentsById.set(parentId, task);
          restoreParents.push({ entry, task });
        }

        if (tasks.length + restoreParents.length > MAX_PARENT_TASK_COUNT) {
          return { ok: false, reason: 'parent-limit' };
        }

        const subtaskCounts = new Map();
        const subtaskIdsByParentId = new Map();
        const ensureSubtaskTracking = (parentId, parent) => {
          if (subtaskIdsByParentId.has(parentId)) return;
          const subtasks = Array.isArray(parent?.subtasks) ? parent.subtasks : [];
          subtaskCounts.set(parentId, subtasks.length);
          subtaskIdsByParentId.set(parentId, new Set(subtasks.map(sub => sub?.id).filter(Boolean)));
        };

        tasks.forEach((task) => ensureSubtaskTracking(task.id, task));
        restoreParents.forEach(({ task }) => ensureSubtaskTracking(task.id, task));

        const restoreSubtasks = [];
        const sortedSubtasks = Array.isArray(payload.removedSubtasks)
          ? payload.removedSubtasks.toSorted((a, b) => (a?.index ?? 0) - (b?.index ?? 0))
          : [];

        for (const entry of sortedSubtasks) {
          const parentId = entry?.parentId;
          const subtaskId = entry?.subtask?.id;
          if (!parentId || !subtaskId) continue;
          const parent = getTask(parentId) || plannedParentsById.get(parentId);
          if (!parent) continue;
          ensureSubtaskTracking(parentId, parent);
          const subtaskIds = subtaskIdsByParentId.get(parentId);
          if (subtaskIds.has(subtaskId)) continue;
          // 子を持たないタスクは、現在の集中セッションが終わるまで実行可能な状態を保つ。
          if (parent.subtasks.length === 0 && parent === getActiveFocusTarget()) {
            return { ok: false, reason: 'active-focus' };
          }
          const nextCount = (subtaskCounts.get(parentId) ?? 0) + 1;
          if (nextCount > MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT) {
            return { ok: false, reason: 'subtask-limit' };
          }
          subtaskIds.add(subtaskId);
          subtaskCounts.set(parentId, nextCount);
          restoreSubtasks.push({
            entry,
            parentId,
            subtask: _copyTaskSnapshot(entry.subtask)
          });
        }

        return {
          ok: true,
          restoreParents,
          restoreSubtasks
        };
      }

      function _applyDeleteUndoPayload(payload) {
        const restorePlan = _createDeleteUndoRestorePlan(payload);
        if (!restorePlan) return false;
        if (!restorePlan.ok) {
          if (restorePlan.reason === 'active-focus') return false;
          if (restorePlan.reason === 'parent-limit') {
            showErrorToast(`親タスクは最大${MAX_PARENT_TASK_COUNT}件までです。空きを作ってから元に戻してください`);
          } else {
            showErrorToast(`子タスクは親タスクごとに最大${MAX_SUBTASK_COUNT_PER_PARENT}件までです。空きを作ってから元に戻してください`);
          }
          return false;
        }
        let changed = false;
        const touchedParentIds = new Set();

        restorePlan.restoreParents.forEach(({ entry, task }) => {
          const insertIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.index)
            ? Math.max(0, Math.min(entry.index, tasks.length))
            : tasks.length;
          tasks.splice(insertIndex, 0, task);
          changed = true;
        });

        restorePlan.restoreSubtasks.forEach(({ entry, parentId, subtask }) => {
          const parent = getTask(parentId);
          if (!parent) return;
          if (!Array.isArray(parent.subtasks)) parent.subtasks = [];
          if (parent.subtasks.length === 0) parent.focus = createFocusMeta();
          const insertIndex = Number.isInteger(entry.index)
            ? Math.max(0, Math.min(entry.index, parent.subtasks.length))
            : parent.subtasks.length;
          parent.subtasks.splice(insertIndex, 0, subtask);
          touchedParentIds.add(parentId);
          changed = true;
        });

        touchedParentIds.forEach((parentId) => {
          const parent = getTask(parentId);
          if (parent) syncParentStatus(parent);
        });

        return changed;
      }

      function _runToastDismissHandler() {
        if (typeof _toastDismissHandler !== 'function') {
          _toastDismissHandler = null;
          return;
        }
        const handler = _toastDismissHandler;
        _toastDismissHandler = null;
        try {
          handler();
        } catch (error) {
          console.warn('[toast:dismiss]', error);
        }

      function _hideToastBySession(sessionId) {
        if (!toastLayer || sessionId !== _toastSessionId) return;
        const toast = qs('.toast', toastLayer);
        if (!toast) {
          toastLayer.replaceChildren();
          _runToastDismissHandler();
          return;
        }
        toast.classList.remove('show');
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (sessionId !== _toastSessionId) return;
          if (toastLayer.contains(toast)) toastLayer.replaceChildren();
          _runToastDismissHandler();
        }, 180);
      }

      function showToast(message, options = {}) {
        const {
          type = 'error',
          icon = type === 'success' ? 'task_alt' : 'error',
          durationMs = type === 'success' ? 1700 : 2200,
          actionLabel = '',
          onAction = null,
          onDismiss = null
        } = options;
        if (!toastLayer) return;
        if (toastHideTimerId) {
          clearTimeout(toastHideTimerId);
          toastHideTimerId = null;
        }
        _runToastDismissHandler();
        _toastSessionId += 1;
        const toastSessionId = _toastSessionId;
        _toastDismissHandler = typeof onDismiss === 'function' ? onDismiss : null;
        const normalizedActionLabel = String(actionLabel || '').trim();
        const hasAction = normalizedActionLabel.length > 0 && typeof onAction === 'function';
        const actionButtonHtml = hasAction
          ? `<button type="button" class="toast-action-btn gm-btn" aria-label="${escapeHtml(normalizedActionLabel)}">${escapeHtml(normalizedActionLabel)}</button>`
          : '';
        toastLayer.innerHTML = `
          <div class="toast ${type}" role="alert">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">${icon}</span>
            <span class="toast-message">${escapeHtml(message)}</span>
            ${actionButtonHtml}
          </div>
        `;
        hydrateMaterialIcons(toastLayer);

        const toast = qs('.toast', toastLayer);
        if (!toast) {
          _runToastDismissHandler();
          return;
        }

        if (hasAction) {
          const toastActionBtn = qs('.toast-action-btn', toast);
          let actionPending = false;
          toastActionBtn?.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (toastSessionId !== _toastSessionId || actionPending || isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
            actionPending = true;
            try {
              await onAction();
            } finally {
              actionPending = false;
              if (toastSessionId === _toastSessionId) {
                if (toastHideTimerId) {
                  clearTimeout(toastHideTimerId);
                  toastHideTimerId = null;
                }
                _hideToastBySession(toastSessionId);
              }
            }
          });
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (toastSessionId !== _toastSessionId) return;
          toast.classList.add('show');
        });

        toastHideTimerId = window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (toastSessionId !== _toastSessionId) return;
          toastHideTimerId = null;
          _hideToastBySession(toastSessionId);
        }, durationMs);
      }

      function showErrorToast(message) {
        showToast(message, { type: 'error', icon: 'error', durationMs: 2200 });
      }

      function _hideDeleteUndoToastBySession(sessionId) {
        if (!deleteUndoToastLayer || sessionId !== _deleteUndoToastSessionId) return;
        const toast = qs('.toast', deleteUndoToastLayer);
        if (!toast) {
          deleteUndoToastLayer.replaceChildren();
          return;
        }
        toast.classList.remove('show');
        window.setTimeout(() => {

        }, 180);
      }

      function _showDeleteUndoToast(message, undoVersion) {
        if (!deleteUndoToastLayer) return false;
        if (_deleteUndoToastHideTimerId) {
          clearTimeout(_deleteUndoToastHideTimerId);
          _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = null;
        }
        _deleteUndoToastSessionId += 1;
        const toastSessionId = _deleteUndoToastSessionId;
        deleteUndoToastLayer.innerHTML = `
          <div class="toast success" role="alert">
            <span class="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">delete</span>
            <span class="toast-message">${escapeHtml(message)}</span>
            <button type="button" class="toast-action-btn toast-undo-action-btn gm-btn" aria-label="元に戻す">元に戻す</button>
          </div>
        `;
        hydrateMaterialIcons(deleteUndoToastLayer);
        const toast = qs('.toast', deleteUndoToastLayer);
        if (!toast) return false;
        const undoBtn = qs('.toast-undo-action-btn', toast);
        undoBtn?.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          if (isStateSaveOperationPending()) return;
          if (toastSessionId !== _deleteUndoToastSessionId) return;
          if (undoVersion !== _deleteUndoState.version) return;
          const previousState = _createAppStateSnapshot();
          if (!_applyDeleteUndoPayload(_deleteUndoState.payload)) return;
          if (!(await _commitStateSave(previousState, '保存できなかったため元に戻せませんでした'))) return;
          _deleteUndoState.payload = null;
          if (_deleteUndoToastHideTimerId) {
            clearTimeout(_deleteUndoToastHideTimerId);
            _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = null;
          }
          _hideDeleteUndoToastBySession(toastSessionId);
          render();
          showToast('削除を元に戻しました', { type: 'success', icon: 'undo' });
        });
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (toastSessionId !== _deleteUndoToastSessionId) return;
          toast.classList.add('show');
        });
        _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (toastSessionId !== _deleteUndoToastSessionId) return;
          _deleteUndoToastHideTimerId = null;
          if (undoVersion === _deleteUndoState.version) {
            _deleteUndoState.payload = null;
          }
          _hideDeleteUndoToastBySession(toastSessionId);
        }, DELETE_UNDO_WINDOW_MS);
        return true;
      }

      function _registerDeleteUndoToast(message, payload) {
        if (!_isValidDeleteUndoPayload(payload)) return;
        _deleteUndoState.payload = _copyTaskSnapshot(payload);
        _deleteUndoState.version += 1;
